items.title: Found this little guy in a soaking wet cardboard box last night on the street, I guess I'm a cat Dad now?
items.content_text: Hello! So, I was walking home last night in the rain, I came across this soaked cardboard box, I opened it up and found this very scared (and wet) little kitten…
